description: Source code for bot management commands in Mattermost CLI, including create, update, list, enable, disable, and assign bot functionalities.

methods.name: botCreateCmdF
methods.description: Creates a new bot with specified username, display name, and description; optionally generates a token.

methods.name: botUpdateCmdF
methods.description: Updates bot information such as username, display name, and description.

methods.name: botListCmdF
methods.description: Lists bots with options for including deleted or orphaned bots, and displays owner info.

methods.name: botEnableCmdF
methods.description: Enables one or more bots based on user arguments.

methods.name: botDisableCmdF
methods.description: Disables one or more bots based on user arguments.

methods.name: botAssignCmdF
methods.description: Assigns ownership of a bot to another user.
